comparison.objective: Raise and remove a head restraint while holding its release, then place it in a box.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual simultaneous release pressing and axial extraction against a breakable lock.
comparison.success_condition: Body awards staged removal and placement credit and permanently fails forced-lock damage; no versioned specs are present.
comparison.reason: It tests latch release plus extraction, not a rotary setting, tool-mediated lock, or repeated dynamic commissioning.
